sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Committee recommendation: Do Not Invest (score -0.51; 2 positive / 4 negative of 6 agents). Dissent: FounderAgent, FinancialAgent (positive).

sections.title: Market Analysis
body: Verdict: negative (score 10/100, confidence 81%).
Technology campaigns fund at 24% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 0.59).
Market timing is unfavorable; the Technology trend is declining (21,646 campaigns).
The category is crowded.

sections.title: Competitive Landscape
body: Verdict: negative (score 17/100, confidence 89%).
Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $10,000 vs $20,000 for those that failed.
Your $25,000 goal is 2.5x the winners' median ($10,000) — priced like the campaigns that failed.
Category is crowded — 21,646 campaigns (8% of all).

sections.title: Founder Assessment (creator execution)
body: Verdict: positive (score 75/100, confidence 50%).
The creator's controllable choices are already near their modeled optimum (40% of a reachable 53%).
Craft gap: Add a number to your title (e.g. an edition or volume number) (~9 pts).
Craft gap: Lower your funding goal from $25,000 to $10,000 (~3 pts).

sections.title: Financial Assessment (funding viability)
body: Verdict: positive (score 64/100, confidence 67%).
Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the category winners' median ($10,000).
Calibrated funding probability 40% vs the 33% decision bar.
Goal-size risk (High): Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the Technology funded-median ($10,000); large goals are harder to reach.

sections.title: Risks & Red Flags
body: Overall risk: High. Modeled failure risk 60%.
High — Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the Technology funded-median ($10,000); large goals are harder to reach.
High — Similar campaigns (Technology, a large goal) funded at only 22% (lift 0.53).
4 investor objection(s) raised; top: goal_size.
Investor objection (High): Your $25,000 goal is high for Technology, where funded campaigns typically ask a median of $10,000. Why this ask — and can you hit it?
Investor objection (High): Among campaigns most like yours (Technology, a large goal), only 22% funded. What sets you apart from the 7,940 that came before?
Investor objection (High): Your 30-day campaign sits in a band that funds at 22% (lift 0.54). Would a shorter campaign convert better?
Investor objection (High): Technology campaigns historically fund at 24% (lift 0.59) — below the 40% baseline. How do you overcome the category headwind?

sections.title: Opportunities
body: Priority changes can lift funding odds from 40% to ~53%.
Working in your favor: campaign_duration.
Working in your favor: title term 'smart'.

honesty_note: Investor Due Diligence Report — a deterministic reformatting of the Day 4-12 analysis (no new analysis). Every section names its source; agents are correlated views of one signal set, not independent experts. Model-simulated, not causal; expected return / comparable rounds / valuation / founder background / financials are deferred (no data).
